:::: {.content-visible unless-format="revealjs"}
a. Under Invite by Email:

    - Enter the user's **Email** address.
    - Select one or more groups from the **Groups** menu. Each group you select appears as a chip. To remove a group, click **{{< fa xmark >}}** on its chip.

        Each user needs at least one group. Selecting only your default group, `All`, is enough. If you click **Send Invite** without a group, the invitation isn't sent and the Groups field asks you to select one.
    - Click **{{< fa plus >}}** under **Role** to assign roles to that user:

        1. Click **{{< fa plus >}}** next to the role for each role to be assigned.
        2. Click **Assign Additional Roles (Optional)**.[^basic-user-role]

b. Click **{{< fa envelope >}} Send Invite**.

    Users will receive an email invitation that they must accept to join your organization. When they accept, they join every group on the invitation and your default group.

::::


<!-- ADDITIONAL FOOTNOTES -->


[^basic-user-role]:

    - Users invited without additional roles applied will be automatically assigned to a [{{< fa wrench >}} Basic User]{.bubble} role with minimal permissions.
    - [Manage user roles](/guide/configuration/manage-users.qmd#manage-user-roles)

:::: {.content-hidden unless-format="revealjs"}

    - Enter the user's **Email** address.
    - Select one or more groups from the **Groups** menu. Each user needs at least one group.
    - Click **{{< fa plus >}}** under **Role** to assign roles to that user:

b. Click **{{< fa envelope >}} Send Invite**.

    Users will receive an email invitation that they must accept to join your organization. When they accept, they join every group on the invitation and your default group.
